game.title: Resonance Loom
game.tagline: A browser rhythm game where your keystrokes weave a live-synthesised melody.

platforms.controls: Keyboard D/F/J/K, or tap lanes; Space to pause, Esc to quit

features: 3 original songs with procedurally-authored note charts
Web Audio API live synthesis — no audio samples or copyrighted material
Per-lane melodic hit feedback (hitting notes plays a rising pentatonic melody)
Pause/resume, restart, and persistent per-song high scores (localStorage)
game.audioNotes: All music is original to this game and synthesised at runtime via oscillators. No third-party audio, no samples, no copyrighted melodies. Each song has its own key: Aurora Drift (A minor), Neon Loom (E minor), Chronos Surge (D minor).

agent.name: GLM-5.2
agent.invocation: Generated as a coding-agent sample after a human requested a review of the aidong27/99-ai-games repository and asked GLM-5.2 to author an original game for the desktop.

humanRole: Provided the prompt (review the repo, then make a game as GLM-5.2).
No human wrote or hand-edited any of the game source files (index.html, style.css, game.js, audio.js, songs.js).
Human may move/rename the folder, run the game, and (optionally) submit it upstream.

relationshipToRepo.repoIntent: A playable archive of browser games generated by AI coding agents, used to observe agent progress over time. Maintainers do not hand-write game code.
relationshipToRepo.thisSubmission: Targets the currently-empty 'Rhythm Audio' hall. Intended as a genuine observation sample of GLM-5.2's single-shot browser-game output.
relationshipToRepo.submittedToRepoNotes: Not (yet) submitted upstream. This game.json mirrors the repo's provenance conventions so it can be offered as a contribution without modification.

honestyNotes: No screenshots, scores, download counts, or 'featured in' claims are fabricated.

The repository could not be cloned in this environment (network restricted to a fetch/web-reader path), so the review was conducted from the public GitHub page and README rather than a local checkout.
This file is authored by the same agent (GLM-5.2) that wrote the game code.

howToRun.desktop: Double-click index.html — opens in any modern browser. No install, no build.
howToRun.tip: Click anywhere first if audio does not start immediately (browsers require a user gesture to unlock sound).
